versions.changelog:
Version 0.0.5 adds clearer, scope-aware guidance and supporting tools for SAS overview queries.

- Clarifies service and feature availability, region and account-site confirmation, query prerequisites, and scope-specific permissions.
- Adds execution feedback guidance for progress, pagination, partial results, and failures.
- Uses the manifest version and a generated session UUID to build one consistent User-Agent for cloud queries.
- Adds reference guides and scripts for query parameters, permissions, CLI validation, inventory, and overview responses.

alibabacloud-sas-overview v0.0.4

- Reduced minimum required Aliyun CLI version from 3.3.3 to 3.3.1 in prerequisites.
- Updated plugin management instructions: manual plugin installation step removed, clarified that plugins are auto-installed with `--auto-plugin-install true`.
- Minor clarifications in the prerequisites section and usage notes.
- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.

- Added "Observability" section: All CLI commands now require a session-specific User-Agent containing a UUIDv4, ensuring per-session request correlation.
- Included clear instructions for session-id generation and consistent usage throughout a skill execution session.
- Documentation now includes all major descriptions in both English and Simplified Chinese.
- Removed the requirement to explicitly enable AI-Mode before command execution; focus is now on User-Agent tracking.
- Minor clarifications and formatting updates in prerequisites and workflow guidelines.
- Removed the unused file: skill-card.md.

**Summary: v0.0.2 introduces required CLI updates, AI-Mode, and stricter prerequisites.**

- Raised minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement to 3.3.3 and added plugin update instructions.
- **[NEW]** Explicit requirement to enable AI-Mode and set User-Agent before executing any CLI commands.
- Clarified/prepended all shell examples and workflow steps to mandate use of the correct User-Agent string for this skill.
- Updated prerequisite checks and installation steps for CLI and plugins in documentation.
- Improved security and parameter confirmation instructions throughout.

- Initial release of the alibabacloud-sas-overview skill.
- Enables querying Alibaba Cloud Security Center (SAS) overview data, including security score, asset status, risk governance, risk trends, and billing info.
- Flexible query scope: single data item, whole module, or full SAS overview based on user request.
- Requires Aliyun CLI ≥ 3.3.1, relevant CLI plugins, and proper Alibaba Cloud credentials (no credential handling in-conversation).
- Out of scope: no remediation actions or modification of settings—overview data queries only.
